text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing training and 
walking Cesario back to the dorm...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Cesario-saaaan!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Spe-san...! Hello. Is something the 
matter?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Mom sent another batch of carrots! So to 
thank you for the other day, please let me 
cook something for you!

"By 'the other day', do you mean when 
Cesario and Buena Vista prepared a healthy 
meal and served it to Special Week while 
she was trying to lose weight?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thank you sooo much! Once the race is 
over, please let me repay you two!

That's what Special Week said back then. 
She probably wants to treat me to a meal 
as thanks for my cooking.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Oh, please, you really didn't need to 
thank me...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
No! It's my fault! Could you call over 
Buena-san too? I'd like to treat you 
both...!

Since they wanted me to join in as well, I 
invited the three of them to my room and 
lent them the kitchen. After waiting for 
several dozen minutes—
(BOOOOOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting! Straight from my 
mama's recipe, it's an extra-large carrot 
hamburg steak!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Whoa...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Incredible...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
For now, I made enough to fill my stomach 
about eighty percent. If it's not enough, 
just let me know!
choice_data_list:
Stopping at eighty percent full... So this 
is it...

text_block_list.text:
Even if Special Week stopped eating at 
eighty percent full, it far surpassed what 
Cesario normally ate. I couldn't help 
thinking it was far too much, but...

text_block_list.name: Cesario & Buena
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! Delicious...!! The meat is so 
juicy, and the carrots are piping hot and 
tender!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Even though it's so hearty, it goes down 
so smoothly! Hehe, I just can't stop 
eating♪

The two showed an unusually hearty 
appetite, devouring the extra-large 
Salisbury steaks in no time.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *phew*... I'm so full...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
When was the last time I felt this 
full...?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, I'm fine. Just let me rest for a 
little bit. My stomach feels so heavy...
choice_data_list: Got it. You can relax until curfew.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, fufu♪ My heart and body are both 
full to the brim...

Lying down and gazing up at the ceiling, 
Cesario wore a genuinely blissful smile.
